What a checked review means

Documented written courses from at least four universities,declared mathematical scope,complete solutions,appropriate diagrams or simulations,and recorded mathematical and rendering checks. Finite audits do not establish literal 100 percent correctness or guarantee every unseen examination result. Exact source provenance and remaining uncertainty are stated in each audit.

The latest local drafts and cloud backup are tracked separately from Site publication. The current Site update remains pending while its official source connection resets.
